My work sits at the intersection of deep learning, human-centred sensing, and intelligent networks. Students are welcome in two ways: join one of my research projects as a research assistant, or do your final project on a topic I supervise. Often the two go together.

title: Research
text:
Research Projects
Funded and ongoing projects I lead. Students contribute as research assistants.




Ongoing 2026


Intelligent Root Cause Analysis System for Network Faults




Funded by Hibah Riset dan Pembuatan Artikel Publikasi 2026Sekolah Vokasi, Universitas Gadjah Mada · Competitive cluster



When a network fails, operators face a flood of alarms and metrics. This project builds an intelligent root cause analysis system that combines time-series analysis of network telemetry with a large language model to pinpoint the underlying cause of a fault and explain it in plain language.

title: Teaching
text:
Teaching Philosophy


إِذِ الْفَتَى حَسْبَ اعْتِقَادِهِ رُفِعْ۞وَكُلُّ مَنْ لَمْ يَعْتَقِدْ لَمْ يَنْتَفِعْ

Idhi l-fatā ḥasba-ʿtiqādihī rufiʿ, wa-kullu man lam yaʿtaqid lam yantafiʿ.
“A learner rises in proportion to his conviction; whoever does not believe in what he learns will not benefit from it.”
— al-ʿImrīṭī, Naẓm al-ʿImrīṭī

This line from a classic poem on Arabic grammar is the heart of how I teach: students rise to the level of their conviction. My job is to help them believe that what they learn matters, and that they are able to master it.

Why before howEvery topic starts from a real problem in networks, data, or systems, so students see why it is worth learning. Learn by buildingLabs and small projects come before memorisation; understanding grows from making things work. Confidence step by stepSmall wins, clear feedback, and room to ask questions turn “I can’t” into “I can”.

title: Curriculum Vitae
text:
Projects

A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Accurate Eye Movement Classification
Master’s thesis · 02/2025 – 06/2025
A lightweight hybrid deep learning model for near real-time eye-movement classification, achieving over 91% F1-score on the GazeCom dataset with only a 20 ms input window, enabling low-latency gaze interaction for assistive technologies.


ACL and Dynamic Control List in Software-Defined Networks with Floodlight Controller
Bachelor’s final project · 09/2017 – 11/2017
A desktop application to manage outbound packet flow via Access Control Lists, extended with a Dynamic Control List that builds firewall rules automatically in collaboration with a honeypot.
